description: Submit one plain-text message under a caller-saved operation ID. Requires an existing inbox's agent key as the Bearer credential; this server cannot create an inbox. Sends only from an inbox whose owner set a recipient allowlist with the content guard on, and only to recipients the owner approved; open inboxes are receive-only. Never retry with a new ID after uncertainty; acceptance is not delivery.
name: voidmail_send_once
title: Submit one plain-text message
